mapper.select: SELECT id,username,NULL accountType,password_hash password,role_code role,person_id personId,status FROM user_account ORDER BY created_at,id

SELECT v.id,v.owner_id ownerId,p.name ownerName,v.license_plate_number plateNo,v.status,DATE_FORMAT(v.last_access_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') lastAccess FROM registered_vehicle v JOIN person_profile p ON p.id=v.owner_id ORDER BY v.id

SELECT v.id,v.owner_id ownerId,p.name ownerName,v.license_plate_number plateNo,v.status,DATE_FORMAT(v.last_access_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') lastAccess FROM registered_vehicle v JOIN person_profile p ON p.id=v.owner_id WHERE v.id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registered_vehicle(id,owner_id,license_plate_number,status,last_access_at) VALUES(#{id},#{ownerId},#{plateNo},#{status},CASE WHEN #{lastAccess} REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} ' THEN STR_TO_DATE(#{lastAccess},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END)
mapper.update: UPDATE registered_vehicle SET owner_id=#{ownerId},license_plate_number=#{plateNo},status=#{status},last_access_at=CASE WHEN #{lastAccess} REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} ' THEN STR_TO_DATE(#{lastAccess},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ELSE last_access_at END WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT f.id,f.person_id personId,p.name personName,f.status,f.file_name fileName,f.image_url imageUrl,f.slot_code slot,f.label,DATE_FORMAT(f.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') updatedAt FROM biometric_credential f JOIN person_profile p ON p.id=f.person_id ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC,f.id
SELECT id,title,content,target_role_code targetRole,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createdAt,is_read `read` FROM notification_message ORDER BY created_at DESC,id
SELECT id,title,content,target_role_code targetRole,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createdAt,is_read `read` FROM notification_message WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,DATE_FORMAT(occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') time,actor_name_snapshot actor,actor_role_snapshot role,action,target,result FROM audit_log ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log(id,occurred_at,actor_name_snapshot,actor_role_snapshot,action,target,result) VALUES(#{id},STR_TO_DATE(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),#{actor},#{role},#{action},#{target},#{result}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.update: UPDATE registered_vehicle SET last_access_at=GREATEST(COALESCE(last_access_at,'1000-01-01'),STR_TO_DATE(#{lastAccess},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_id=#{ownerId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registered_vehicle WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND id != #{exceptId}
